title: Next Greater Signal
description: For every value in an integer array, find the first value to its right that is strictly greater. If no greater value exists, print -1 for that position.
inputFormat: First line: n. Second line: n integers.
outputFormat: Print n answers separated by spaces.
hints: Process values from right to left and maintain a decreasing stack of useful candidates.

examples.explanation: For each position, the first larger value to its right is selected.
No value has a greater element to its right.
